# Biographical Statement 

Digital Humanities and research data specialist with more than ten years of experience in digital collections, metadata, scholarly editions and research infrastructures. Experienced in coordinating collaborative workflows, documenting research data and developing reusable Open Science resources.

# Employment

- **Apr. 2025–present**: Digital Humanities Research Associate  
  Freie Universität Berlin  
  Open Science workflows, training resources and documentation for the DraCor research infrastructure.

- **Apr. 2023–Mar. 2026**: Digital Humanities Research Associate  
  University of Tübingen  
  Research data modelling, TEI corpus development and computational analysis for CalDraCor.

- **Jun. 2019–Apr. 2024**: Digital Humanities Research Associate  
  Berlin-Brandenburg Academy of Sciences and Humanities  
  Digital editions, metadata integration, usability testing and data publication for Proyecto Humboldt Digital.

# Core Competencies

- **Research data and Open Science:** data management, FAIR principles, documentation, reproducible workflows, repository preparation
- **Digital collections and metadata:** TEI/XML, metadata modelling, digital scholarly editions, authority data, IIIF
- **Technical methods:** Python, Jupyter, XSLT, Git, APIs, data validation and transformation
- **Communication and coordination:** technical documentation, training, workshops, collaborative project workflows
- **Languages:** Spanish and Catalan (native), English (C1), German (B2), French (reading)
